label: DC reference values
notice: reference ranges only, not prices or offers
method: Services: hourly_avg is the OEWS hourly median, or the mean of p25 and p75 if the median is missing. job_avg is the midpoint of a job low-high span when one exists. avg_value_usd is job_avg when present, otherwise hourly_avg. Goods: avg_value_usd is the listed unit price. Pending series stay null.
